text: Automatic English captions cover the complete substantive exchange recorded in 2008. Twenty-five selected passages were checked against the audio; uncertain words and speaker-ambiguous interruptions are excluded from quotations and separate credit. Introductions and moderator logistics are not scored. Boteach explicitly accepts guided evolution, while Hitchens distinguishes uncertainty about a first cause from his criticism of an interventionist God. Historical and scientific claims are assessed as arguments made in the exchange, not certified as facts by transcription. Short quotations retain verified source wording; argument cards are faithful condensations.
